knowledge.title: Founder-led AI experiments
knowledge.summary: Janani AI focuses on founder-led discovery sprints that validate AI-native workflows within two weeks.

knowledge.title: Customer research loops
knowledge.summary: Weekly customer calls feed a backlog of workflow pains; top items are prototyped with lightweight agents.

knowledge.title: Evaluation rubric
knowledge.summary: Shipping criteria: 80% task coverage, clear handoff to humans, and observable metrics in 72 hours.

knowledge.title: Modern data stack costs
knowledge.summary: Teams report 25-40% cloud waste from orphaned warehouses and idle notebooks.

knowledge.title: Lakehouse governance
knowledge.summary: Delta-style tables with row-level policies reduce breach risk when paired with fine-grained service accounts.

knowledge.title: Metrics layer adoption
knowledge.summary: Semantic layers cut dashboard lead time by ~30% but require central ownership and contract tests.

knowledge.title: Adaptive tutoring
knowledge.summary: LLM tutors that mirror student language improve quiz scores ~12% when paired with weekly teacher feedback loops.

knowledge.title: Academic integrity
knowledge.summary: Watermark-only detectors fail; portfolio assessments plus oral defenses remain the reliable check.

knowledge.title: Device equity
knowledge.summary: Schools moving to browser-first AI tools reduce device disparities and simplify compliance.

knowledge.title: Frontier model budgets
knowledge.summary: Frontier model training pushes budgets above $500M; efficiency work targets sparsity and server-side batching.

knowledge.title: Policy momentum
knowledge.summary: US and EU advance AI safety rules on synthetic media disclosure and model incident reporting.

knowledge.title: Open tooling surge
knowledge.summary: Smaller labs ship agent orchestration and eval harnesses with permissive licenses, accelerating startup adoption.
